$comment: Font manifest. Binaries are NEVER in the repo (licence: no redistribution, hosting or extraction). Each cut is looked up in fontDirs in order; ${VAR} expands from the environment. Set BW_FONT_DIR to the folder holding thmanyahseriftext/, thmanyahserifdisplay/, thmanyahsans/ (each with otf/ and woff2/), or to the folder of converted .ttf files. .ttf is preferred: Chrome prints CFF outlines (.otf/.woff2) as Type 3.

Thmanyah Serif Display.use: cover title, headings, chapter chips, spine code

Thmanyah Sans.use: editor interface only; not used in documents

weightUse.300: only where a design already uses a light weight

uploadSlot: fonts/custom/ (gitignored; only its README is tracked)
